question: Keep Chafa and Maya Lopez? Chafa is the first Choctaw, an ancestor who lived centuries before Maya; they never meet, and Maya only hears her legend and sees her in visions (blood tie never met, visions are not events). But the MCU wiki says Chafa's power echoes down her line and Maya channels Chafa and the other ancestors to defeat Kingpin, which could count as huge consequences for Maya.
options: Keep (Chafa's echoed power shapes Maya's defeat of Kingpin)
Drop (blood tie never met, contact only in visions)
their_evidence: Fandom: Bonnie tells young Maya the legend of Chafa (Echo#1); Maya sees visions of Chafa, Lowak, Tuklo and Chula; in Echo#5 Maya channels her ancestors, including Chafa, to defeat Kingpin. Chafa appears to Maya only in flashbacks, sculpture, vision and illusion.

connection.b_desc: A Choctaw fighter breaking free of Fisk

stages.title: Echo#2
stages.text: Chafa is one of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A descendant who sees Chafa's story in visions.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.

question: Keep Chafa and Tuklo? Chafa is the first Choctaw, living ages before Tuklo; they never meet in the flesh. Tuklo only has a vision of Chafa (and Lowak) before her powers wake, which the show presents as the ancestors echoing through their descendants. Does that ancestral echo count as a tie under the implied-ties rule, or is it a blood tie never met plus a vision, both of which stay out under N7?
their_evidence: Echo#3 "Tuklo": in the late 1800s Tuklo kneels by Nanih Waiya, her hands glow, she has a vision of Chafa and Lowak and senses the Lighthorsemen are in trouble. Chafa is the first Choctaw from the origin story (Echo#1). The two never appear together except in that vision. Not flagged for dropping because the show treats the ancestors echoing to their descendants as a real power.

connection.b_desc: A Choctaw girl in the late 1800s

stages.title: Echo#3
stages.text: Tuklo is a descendant of Chafa. When her father refuses to let her join the Lighthorsemen, visions of Chafa and Lowak warn her they are in trouble, and she tracks down the men who ambushed them and kills them all.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A descendant. A vision of Chafa gives her strength to rescue the Lighthorsemen.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tuklo's ancestor, the first Choctaw, whose vision gives Tuklo strength to fight.

their_evidence: A blood tie never met. N'Jobu is killed by T'Chaka in Oakland in spring 1992; Shuri is born in the late 1990s, as the stage text itself says ('years before she is born'). They never meet, not even in the ancestral plane (T'Challa sees T'Chaka, Erik sees N'Jobu). Shuri only hears of him and visits the building where he died. His own actions have no direct consequence for her; any effect on her runs through his son Erik, who keeps his own tie with Shuri.

connection.a_desc: A Wakandan prince undercover in Oakland
connection.b_desc: T'Challa's successor as Black Panther

stages.on_a_card_about_b: N'Jobu's niece, born years after T'Chaka kills him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's uncle, killed by her father before she is born.

question: J.A.R.V.I.S. and Edwin Jarvis never meet: the AIs only learn from Stark's old records that Tony modeled J.A.R.V.I.S. on Edwin, and in Vision's mind J.A.R.V.I.S. wears his face. Is being the human model for an AI a tie you want kept, or is this knowing ABOUT someone from records (drop)?
options: keep (Edwin is the inspiration behind J.A.R.V.I.S.)
drop (they never meet; knowing about from records)
their_evidence: Wikipedia's VisionQuest page: in the Mindspace, J.A.R.V.I.S.'s human avatar is a butler-like figure resembling Edwin Jarvis, who served as the inspiration for his creation. The stage text itself says the two never meet.

connection.b_desc: Howard Stark's loyal butler

stages.title: VisionQuest#4

stages.on_a_card_about_b: The Stark family butler Tony modeled J.A.R.V.I.S. on.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's AI, named for and modeled on Jarvis.
